title: SimulaGPU Anki deck source
description: Shape of a file in anki/cards/. Validated by anki/scripts/build-anki.mjs; this document is the reference the script implements and the contract an editor can use for completion.

notetype.description: Anki note type. Only 'Basic' (front/back) is supported in v0.1.

leccion.description: Site-relative path of the lesson these cards belong to.

id.description: Stable identifier, e.g. 'idx-011'. Never reused, never renumbered: it is what keeps a learner's review history attached to the card. Also the sort key of the generated TSV.

tipo.description: Category of the question. Used to check the deck covers every required area.

reverso.description:
Answer side. Spanish, learner-facing. Limited HTML is allowed (,
, ).

etiquetas.description: Anki tags. Lowercase, no spaces, no accents.
